title: Senior Product Engineer - RF
desc:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
Come join Analog Devices – a place where Innovation meets Impact. For the past 50 years, Analog Devices has been inventing innovative technologies that transform lives. Get hands-on experience working with the brightest minds to solve complex problems that matter - from autonomous vehicles, drones and factories to augmented reality to remote healthcare. Enjoy a culture that values aligned goals, balanced work-life priorities, continuous learning throughout your career and shared rewards. At ADI, we invest in you and succeed together because we believe that happy, healthy, intellectually challenged people drive our growth and market leadership.
About the Role:
Analog Devices is seeking to hire a senior product engineer to support the development of RF/microwave designs to be used in Communications, Test & Measurement Instrumentation, Industrial, and Aerospace and Defense.
At Analog Devices, you will lead complex electronic component development initiatives and qualification efforts for multiple product lines. You will apply your technical expertise to optimize production processes and provide guidance to junior engineers. Your role involves cross-functional collaboration to ensure product quality meets ADI's high standards of excellence. This exciting role will offer the opportunity to work with and learn from some of our top industry leading RF and microwave professionals.
Apply now for the opportunity to grow your career and help innovate ahead of what’s possible.
Product Engineer to support product development of microwave and communication products within our RF Systems strategy under Aerospace Defense and Communication Group Business Unit.
Key Responsibilities:
Conduct analysis and testing to ensure product performance and reliability.
Must have strong knowledge and hands-on experience in µWave/mmWave measurement techniques and test equipment.
Provide product development expertise, leading system design, development, and implementation of new products from concept to launch.
Lead qualification efforts for multiple product lines
Independently design and develop required test hardware from concept to production for the new products.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure product design meets customer needs and requirements.
Create technical documentations such as test plans, product datasheets, user guides.
Independently evaluate, select, and modify standard techniques, procedures, and criteria.
Flexibility to work on a variety of projects with various levels of difficulty.
Develop and maintain project work breakdown structures, schedules, and budgets.
Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
Continuously improve product development processes and methodologies.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering.
Minimum 5 years of work experience
Knowledge of the basic concepts of analog RF and microwave electronics.
Strong knowledge of RF engineering principles, materials, and manufacturing processes.
Knowledge of statistical methods and data analysis tools.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in CAD software (PCB layout tools, Cadence Allegro) and other relevant engineering tools.
Strong time management and multi-tasking skills
Ability to work effectively and independently in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Desired Skill Set:
Knowledge of the basic concepts of analog RF and microwave electronics.
Hands-on experience of using instruments in the lab.
Coursework or exposure in one or more of the following Digital Signal Processing, Wireless Communication, Digital Communication, RF Systems, RF Circuits
Excellent analytical skills: critical thinking, problem solving and data analysis.
Familiarity with the use of programming/scripting tools such as C programming, Python, LabVIEW a plus
Good initiative and motivation in a challenging environment.
Strong team worker within multi-discipline and multi-cultural environments
Self-motivated and fast learner with strong technical, analytical and communication skills.
If this job posting draws your interest, we would love to hear from you!
